1. **Modulo 3 Analysis:**
   \[ m^3 \equiv 3n^2 + 3n + 7 \pmod{3} \]

   \[ m^3 \equiv 1 \pmod{3} \]
   This implies \( m \equiv 1 \pmod{3} \).
